description.zh: 使用无副作用算术、字符串、变量和控制结构 marker，验证 Django Template Language 是否把非可信输入当作模板源码求值，并区分普通变量插值与模板注入。
description.en: Use side-effect-free arithmetic, string, variable, and control-flow markers to test whether Django Template Language evaluates untrusted input as template source and distinguish ordinary interpolation from template injection.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无网络出口的本地 Django Fixture，并记录引擎版本、模板入口和启用的扩展或安全模式。
prerequisites.en: Use a no-egress local Django fixture and record engine version, template entry, and enabled extensions or security mode.

prerequisites.zh: 为每个请求分配唯一 marker 和 request_id，响应只返回渲染结果与模板名称，不暴露 Context 对象。
prerequisites.en: Assign a unique marker and request_id to every request; responses expose only rendered output and template name, not context objects.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Django 模板注入的无副作用求值边界验证：以算术、字符串规范化、变量与集合、条件序列、迭代默认值五类 marker 确认输入是否被当作 DTL 模板源码求值。Django 模板语言不支持任意 Python 表达式，验证需按其 Filter/Tag 语义进行。
overview.en: Covers side-effect-free evaluation-boundary verification for Django template injection: five marker families (arithmetic, string normalization, variables and collections, conditions and sequences, iteration and defaults) determine whether input is evaluated as DTL template source. Django's template language does not support arbitrary Python expressions, so verification follows its Filter/Tag semantics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把请求文本传给 Template() 等动态模板构造，文本被 Django 模板引擎编译求值；DTL 不支持任意 Python 表达式，算术验证必须走内置 Filter 或 Tag，模板源码与数据边界缺失即构成注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application passing request text into dynamic template construction such as Template(), where the Django engine compiles and evaluates it; DTL lacks arbitrary Python expressions, so arithmetic checks must use built-in Filters or Tags, and a missing source/data boundary constitutes injection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交第 1-5 步的算术（按 DTL 语义用内置 Filter 表达）、字符串、变量集合、条件与迭代默认值 marker；输出出现 marker 计算结果而非原文即确认模板求值成立。不能套用 Jinja2 乘法语法；被 WAF 拦截时改用管道过滤器与内建函数语义变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first submit plain text to establish a literal-output baseline, then submit the step 1-5 arithmetic (expressed via built-in Filters per DTL semantics), string, variable/collection, condition, and iteration/default markers one by one; output showing the marker's computed result instead of the original text confirms template evaluation. Do not reuse Jinja2 multiplication syntax; when blocked by a WAF, switch to pipe-filter and built-in-function-semantics variants.

mitigation.zh: 用户输入只作为命名 Context 变量传入固定模板，禁止运行时 Template() 编译用户文本，保持 Django 自动转义开启；修复后 marker 载荷应原样输出，并为模板边界添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Pass user input only as named Context variables into fixed templates, forbid runtime Template() compilation of user text, and keep Django autoescaping on; after the fix, marker payloads must output verbatim, with regression tests on the template boundary.

title.zh: 建立 Django 字面基线

description.zh: 提交普通 marker 并记录未求值的原始输出、模板名称和 request_id。
description.en: Submit a plain marker and record unevaluated output, template name, and request_id.

title.zh: 提交 Django 算术 Marker

description.zh: 使用该引擎有效的无副作用算术语法，确认是否发生模板求值。
description.en: Use valid side-effect-free arithmetic syntax for the engine to determine whether template evaluation occurs.

title.zh: 使用第二种语义复核

description.zh: 通过字符串、变量或条件 marker 排除硬编码数值、缓存和响应替换误报。
description.en: Use a string, variable, or conditional marker to exclude hard-coded values, caching, and response substitution.

title.zh: 修复后回归全部 Marker

description.zh: 修复后要求用户表达式按字面输出或作为普通变量转义，同时正常模板功能保持。
description.en: After remediation, require user expressions to render literally or as escaped data while preserving normal template behavior.

analysis.zh: Django 阳性需要两个不同 marker 稳定求值并能定位到动态模板源码构造点。单个 49、模板错误、引擎指纹或普通变量输出都不足以确认 SSTI；更高影响必须由独立、版本匹配且无副作用的 Gadget 证据证明。
analysis.en: A positive Django result requires two distinct markers to evaluate consistently and map to dynamic template-source construction. One value of 49, a template error, engine fingerprint, or ordinary variable output is insufficient; higher impact needs separate, version-matched, side-effect-free gadget evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用算术、字符串和控制结构 marker，不读取 Context、配置、文件、环境变量或网络资源。
opsecTips.en: Use only arithmetic, string, and control-flow markers without reading context, configuration, files, environment variables, or network resources.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只提交一个表达式并限制响应长度，出现编译器异常增长、Worker 抖动或非预期对象输出时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit one expression at a time with a response-size cap, stopping on compiler-error growth, worker instability, or unexpected object output.

review.rationale: Django Template Language 条目保留为模板表达式 Payload，但移除对象遍历、配置泄露、文件读取、进程执行、反弹 Shell 和规避链，改为引擎准确的无副作用 marker。

prerequisites.en: Use a no-egress local Mako fixture and record engine version, template entry, and enabled extensions or security mode.

prerequisites.zh: 为每个请求分配唯一 marker 和 request_id，响应只返回渲染结果与模板名称，不暴露 Context 对象。
prerequisites.en: Assign a unique marker and request_id to every request; responses expose only rendered output and template name, not context objects.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Mako 模板注入的无副作用求值边界验证：以算术、字符串规范化、变量与集合、条件序列、迭代默认值五类 marker 确认输入是否被当作模板源码编译求值。Mako 模板可含 Python 表达式与代码块，需区分数据进入 Context 与文本被编译两种路径。
overview.en: Covers side-effect-free evaluation-boundary verification for Mako template injection: five marker families (arithmetic, string normalization, variables and collections, conditions and sequences, iteration and defaults) determine whether input is compiled as template source. Mako templates can contain Python expressions and code blocks, so data-into-Context must be separated from text-being-compiled.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把请求文本传给 Template() 等动态模板构造，Mako 把其编译为可含 Python 表达式与代码块的模板源码；用户数据进入 Context 与用户文本被编译为模板源码是两条路径，后者边界缺失即构成注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application passing request text into dynamic template construction such as Template(), where Mako compiles it into template source that may contain Python expressions and code blocks; user data entering Context and user text compiled as template source are distinct paths, and a missing boundary on the latter constitutes injection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交第 1-5 步的算术、字符串、变量集合、条件与迭代默认值 marker；输出出现 marker 计算结果而非原文即确认模板求值成立。每次只改变一个表达式并记录渲染结果；被 WAF 拦截时改用等价拼接语法与内建函数语义变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first submit plain text to establish a literal-output baseline, then submit the step 1-5 arithmetic, string, variable/collection, condition, and iteration/default markers one by one; output showing the marker's computed result instead of the original text confirms template evaluation. Change one expression per submission and record render results; when blocked by a WAF, switch to equivalent-concatenation and built-in-function-semantics variants.

mitigation.zh: 用户输入只作为命名 Context 变量传入固定模板文件，禁止运行时 Template() 编译用户文本并启用过滤与转义；修复后 marker 载荷应原样输出，并为模板边界添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Pass user input only as named Context variables into fixed template files, forbid runtime Template() compilation of user text, and enable filtering and escaping; after the fix, marker payloads must output verbatim, with regression tests on the template boundary.

title.zh: 建立 Mako 字面基线

description.zh: 提交普通 marker 并记录未求值的原始输出、模板名称和 request_id。
description.en: Submit a plain marker and record unevaluated output, template name, and request_id.

title.zh: 提交 Mako 算术 Marker

description.zh: 使用该引擎有效的无副作用算术语法，确认是否发生模板求值。
description.en: Use valid side-effect-free arithmetic syntax for the engine to determine whether template evaluation occurs.

title.zh: 使用第二种语义复核

description.zh: 通过字符串、变量或条件 marker 排除硬编码数值、缓存和响应替换误报。
description.en: Use a string, variable, or conditional marker to exclude hard-coded values, caching, and response substitution.

title.zh: 修复后回归全部 Marker

description.zh: 修复后要求用户表达式按字面输出或作为普通变量转义，同时正常模板功能保持。
description.en: After remediation, require user expressions to render literally or as escaped data while preserving normal template behavior.

analysis.zh: Mako 阳性需要两个不同 marker 稳定求值并能定位到动态模板源码构造点。单个 49、模板错误、引擎指纹或普通变量输出都不足以确认 SSTI；更高影响必须由独立、版本匹配且无副作用的 Gadget 证据证明。
analysis.en: A positive Mako result requires two distinct markers to evaluate consistently and map to dynamic template-source construction. One value of 49, a template error, engine fingerprint, or ordinary variable output is insufficient; higher impact needs separate, version-matched, side-effect-free gadget evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用算术、字符串和控制结构 marker，不读取 Context、配置、文件、环境变量或网络资源。
opsecTips.en: Use only arithmetic, string, and control-flow markers without reading context, configuration, files, environment variables, or network resources.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只提交一个表达式并限制响应长度，出现编译器异常增长、Worker 抖动或非预期对象输出时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit one expression at a time with a response-size cap, stopping on compiler-error growth, worker instability, or unexpected object output.

review.rationale: Mako 条目保留为模板表达式 Payload，但移除对象遍历、配置泄露、文件读取、进程执行、反弹 Shell 和规避链，改为引擎准确的无副作用 marker。

mitigation.en: Pass user input only as named assign variables into fixed templates, forbid runtime compilation of user text, and enable $security_policy to restrict tags and PHP access; after the fix, marker payloads must output verbatim, with regression tests on the template boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无网络出口的本地 Tornado Fixture，并记录引擎版本、模板入口和启用的扩展或安全模式。
prerequisites.en: Use a no-egress local Tornado fixture and record engine version, template entry, and enabled extensions or security mode.

prerequisites.zh: 为每个请求分配唯一 marker 和 request_id，响应只返回渲染结果与模板名称，不暴露 Context 对象。
prerequisites.en: Assign a unique marker and request_id to every request; responses expose only rendered output and template name, not context objects.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Tornado 模板注入的无副作用求值边界验证：以算术、字符串规范化、变量与集合、条件序列、迭代默认值五类 marker 确认输入是否被当作模板源码编译求值。Tornado 模板表达式会被编译为 Python 代码执行。
overview.en: Covers side-effect-free evaluation-boundary verification for Tornado template injection: five marker families (arithmetic, string normalization, variables and collections, conditions and sequences, iteration and defaults) determine whether input is compiled as template source. Tornado template expressions compile into Python code.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把请求文本传给 t.template.Template 等动态模板构造，Tornado 把模板表达式编译为 Python 代码执行；应用必须只把非可信值作为 Context 数据传入，模板源码与数据边界缺失即构成注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application passing request text into dynamic template construction such as t.template.Template: Tornado compiles template expressions into Python code. Applications must pass untrusted values only as Context data, and a missing source/data boundary constitutes injection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交第 1-5 步的算术、字符串、变量集合、条件与迭代默认值 marker；输出出现 marker 计算结果而非原文即确认模板求值成立。每次只改变一个表达式并记录渲染结果；被 WAF 拦截时改用等价拼接语法、内建函数语义与属性默认值变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first submit plain text to establish a literal-output baseline, then submit the step 1-5 arithmetic, string, variable/collection, condition, and iteration/default markers one by one; output showing the marker's computed result instead of the original text confirms template evaluation. Change one expression per submission and record render results; when blocked by a WAF, switch to equivalent-concatenation, built-in-function-semantics, and attribute-default variants.

mitigation.zh: 用户输入只作为命名 Context 变量传入固定模板文件，禁止运行时编译用户文本并启用 autoescape（Tornado 默认 xhtml_escape）；修复后 marker 载荷应原样输出，并为模板边界添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Pass user input only as named Context variables into fixed template files, forbid runtime compilation of user text, and keep autoescape on (Tornado's default xhtml_escape); after the fix, marker payloads must output verbatim, with regression tests on the template boundary.

title.zh: 建立 Tornado 字面基线

description.zh: 提交普通 marker 并记录未求值的原始输出、模板名称和 request_id。
description.en: Submit a plain marker and record unevaluated output, template name, and request_id.

title.zh: 提交 Tornado 算术 Marker

description.zh: 使用该引擎有效的无副作用算术语法，确认是否发生模板求值。
description.en: Use valid side-effect-free arithmetic syntax for the engine to determine whether template evaluation occurs.

title.zh: 使用第二种语义复核

description.zh: 通过字符串、变量或条件 marker 排除硬编码数值、缓存和响应替换误报。
description.en: Use a string, variable, or conditional marker to exclude hard-coded values, caching, and response substitution.

title.zh: 修复后回归全部 Marker

description.zh: 修复后要求用户表达式按字面输出或作为普通变量转义，同时正常模板功能保持。
description.en: After remediation, require user expressions to render literally or as escaped data while preserving normal template behavior.

analysis.zh: Tornado 阳性需要两个不同 marker 稳定求值并能定位到动态模板源码构造点。单个 49、模板错误、引擎指纹或普通变量输出都不足以确认 SSTI；更高影响必须由独立、版本匹配且无副作用的 Gadget 证据证明。
analysis.en: A positive Tornado result requires two distinct markers to evaluate consistently and map to dynamic template-source construction. One value of 49, a template error, engine fingerprint, or ordinary variable output is insufficient; higher impact needs separate, version-matched, side-effect-free gadget evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用算术、字符串和控制结构 marker，不读取 Context、配置、文件、环境变量或网络资源。
opsecTips.en: Use only arithmetic, string, and control-flow markers without reading context, configuration, files, environment variables, or network resources.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只提交一个表达式并限制响应长度，出现编译器异常增长、Worker 抖动或非预期对象输出时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit one expression at a time with a response-size cap, stopping on compiler-error growth, worker instability, or unexpected object output.

review.rationale: Tornado Templates 条目保留为模板表达式 Payload，但移除对象遍历、配置泄露、文件读取、进程执行、反弹 Shell 和规避链，改为引擎准确的无副作用 marker。

description.zh: 使用无副作用算术、字符串、变量和控制结构 marker，验证 Apache Velocity 是否把非可信输入当作模板源码求值，并区分普通变量插值与模板注入。
description.en: Use side-effect-free arithmetic, string, variable, and control-flow markers to test whether Apache Velocity evaluates untrusted input as template source and distinguish ordinary interpolation from template injection.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无网络出口的本地 Velocity Fixture，并记录引擎版本、模板入口和启用的扩展或安全模式。
prerequisites.en: Use a no-egress local Velocity fixture and record engine version, template entry, and enabled extensions or security mode.

prerequisites.zh: 为每个请求分配唯一 marker 和 request_id，响应只返回渲染结果与模板名称，不暴露 Context 对象。
prerequisites.en: Assign a unique marker and request_id to every request; responses expose only rendered output and template name, not context objects.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Velocity 模板注入的无副作用求值边界验证：以算术、字符串规范化、变量与集合、条件序列、迭代默认值五类 marker 确认输入是否被当作模板源码编译求值。适用于探测 Java/Velocity 渲染入口的场景。
overview.en: Covers side-effect-free evaluation-boundary verification for Velocity template injection: five marker families (arithmetic, string normalization, variables and collections, conditions and sequences, iteration and defaults) determine whether input is compiled as template source. Suitable for probing Java/Velocity render entry points.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把请求文本传给动态模板构造或字符串模板 API，文本被 Velocity 编译为模板源码求值；可访问对象和方法由 Context、Uberspector 与安全配置决定，模板源码与数据边界缺失即构成注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application passing request text into dynamic template construction or string-template APIs, where Velocity compiles it as template source; accessible objects and methods are governed by the Context, Uberspector, and security configuration, and the missing source/data boundary constitutes injection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交第 1-5 步的算术、字符串、变量集合、条件与迭代默认值 marker；输出出现 marker 计算结果而非原文即确认模板求值成立。每次只改变一个表达式并记录渲染结果；被 WAF 拦截时改用等价拼接语法与内建函数语义变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first submit plain text to establish a literal-output baseline, then submit the step 1-5 arithmetic, string, variable/collection, condition, and iteration/default markers one by one; output showing the marker's computed result instead of the original text confirms template evaluation. Change one expression per submission and record render results; when blocked by a WAF, switch to equivalent-concatenation and built-in-function-semantics variants.

mitigation.zh: 用户输入只作为命名 Context 变量传入固定模板，禁止运行时编译用户文本，收紧 SecureUberspector 等反射策略；修复后 marker 载荷应原样输出，并为模板边界添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Pass user input only as named Context variables into fixed templates, forbid runtime compilation of user text, and tighten reflective policies such as SecureUberspector; after the fix, marker payloads must output verbatim, with regression tests on the template boundary.
